reponse: The flag was renamed and is no longer read from `.env.local`: set `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` no longer works, since flags are served by the API and `FEATURE_FLAGS` is ignored [2][3]. Instead run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` for the dev workspace, with the API running, then hard-reload the page [2][3]. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. The older Slack advice to set `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` is outdated [1]. The rollout plan confirms the flag name is `dashboards_v2` [4].
